title: Fourier expansion of an affine subspace indicator
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $(\mathbf F_2)^n$ and let $a\in(\mathbf F_2)^n$. For every $x\in(\mathbf F_2)^n$, the indicator of $a+H$ at $x$ equals $2^{-\operatorname{codim}(H)}$ times the sum over all $\gamma$ perpendicular to $H$ of $(-1)^{\sum_{i=1}^n\gamma_i(x_i+a_i)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $(\mathbf F_2)^n$
the equality holds as functions, hence for every $x\in(\mathbf F_2)^n$
